Jun 29 2026 (49-slate CSV backtest, consolidated): a RANKING BADGE — NOT a grade. Single tier. Prior two-tier system (Super Nuclear + Nuclear) was retired after backtest showed the second tier had no independent edge (22.2% HR, p=0.762). SigScore gate was also removed — SigScore is a hit-primary signal with no validated HR predictive power. Fires when ALL FOUR HR-relevant gates align: (1) Power ≥ 84 — composite power score (0-100). NOTE (fixed Jul 1 2026): this is NOT a check of the 9-gate Must-Have batted-ball filter below — that's a separate, independent system. A batter can be ☢️ NUCLEAR without passing any Must-Have gates, and vice versa; (2) Odds ≤ +399 — market not fading the pick; (3) PM 1.02-1.08 — matchup favorable but not yet fully priced in; (4) Score < 66 — rules out stat-inflated picks where park/env/runs drove the score. Backtest: 39.1% HR (2.06x, p=0.027, n=45, ~0.9 picks/slate). ANNOTATION flag only — does not change PLAY/LEAN/PASS designation. Prepended to rationale as leading label for immediate identification of top HR targets.

Jul 1 2026 — REPLACES the old DTP (7 gates), Must-Have (10 gates), and Nuclear (13 gates) systems, which had drifted into three overlapping, inconsistently-thresholded lists that didn't match Harrison's real PropFinder filter. This is now the single canonical 9-criterion checklist, taken directly from his PropFinder screenshot: ISO>0.2 · Barrel%>15 · HH%>40 · Air%>50 · GB%<40 · PullBrl%>10 · FB%>35 · Blast%>15 · Pull%>30. PullBrl% uses the real Statcast-derived rate when available (flagged as 0.0 when no pulled barrels recorded in L10 BBEs for batters missing from the Savant Table 5 export). Note printed as '🔵 PropFinder [N/9 must-have]: ...' with the specific gates passed/failed listed. SCORING IMPACT (revised Jul 1 2026 — this should be the single biggest conv bump on the slate): tiered conv boost — 9/9 → +20 conv (also fires ☢️☢️ SUPER NUCLEAR, see below), 8/9 → +12 conv, 7/9 → +8 conv, 6/9 → +4 conv, 3-5/9 → +1 conv (flat band), below 3/9 → no conv impact (note-only). ELITE CONTACT PROFILE BONUS (Jul 1 2026): an additional +5 conv fires whenever BOTH PullBrl%>10 AND FB%>35 clear simultaneously, stackable on top of whatever count-based tier the batter already earns — including 9/9 (total +25 in that case). These two gates are the highest-priority criteria: PullBrl% directly measures the HR-specific contact type, and FB% gates the launch angle profile needed to elevate the ball. Their co-occurrence is flagged visibly in the rationale as '🔥 ELITE CONTACT PROFILE: PullBrl%>X + FB%>Y — both elite HR-profile gates clear (+5 conv bonus, stackable)'. For reference, the model's other top validated boosts (PWR-VULN-ENV, SWEET★ EDGE SPIKE, L2 BLOWUP+VULN52 combo) cap at +15 — 9/9 here is intentionally set above that ceiling. Requires Power data loaded (avoids false positives from default-value batters). A SEPARATE, second model — not a grade or flag on the primary scoring path. Slate-conditional L2 logistic regression (C=0.005), isotonic-calibrated, fitted on 30 quantitative + PropFinder features: odds (log-transformed + band flags), Vuln (+ band flags), PM (+ band), Env, Park, Est PA, Hit Score, Sig (+ band), Edge, lineup-confirmed status, all 9 PropFinder stats, and PF gate count. ⚠️ DOES NOT USE NAMED QUALITATIVE GRADES — no archetype codes, no PropFinder-gate combo flags, none of the hand-tuned Conv-score boosts. Purely quantitative. 'power' was REMOVED as a feature 2026-08-31: its fitted coefficient (-0.113, the model's 2nd-largest) was driven entirely by 18 corrupted training rows (mostly elite bats — Tatis, Bogaerts, Acuña, Witt, Schwarber — with implausible Power readings); removing those 18 rows collapses the coefficient to +0.002. power_deadzone (77-82) is KEPT — it survives independently as a real effect. Fitted on 48 slates (Jun 25-Aug 17 2026), n=3,218, base 15.44%. OUTPUTS: newconv_raw (continuous pre-calibration score — THIS is what ranking uses, never CONV100/newconv_p, which tie by design on the calibrator's flat steps); newconv_p (calibrated probability, weak standalone — Brier 0.1274 vs 0.1282 flat base, i.e. barely better than guessing the base rate — use as a RANKER only, never for bet-sizing); CONV100 (0-100 display scale, p/0.35 ceiling). PURPOSE: fills the 2 NEWCONV slots in the 3-0-2 card structure (top newconv_rank among NEG-eligible batters not already in a Score slot) — a genuinely independent second opinion alongside the primary Score composite, not a refinement of it. ⚠️ 'Conv Score' (0-50, hand-tuned PLAY/LEAN/PASS points) appears in the SAME Detailed-sheet row and is a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT, unrelated system — same word, two systems, do not conflate them. Computed INLINE in mlb_hr_model.py since 2026-09-03 (compute_newconv_scores(), run right before the xlsx is saved, so it reaches the archive) — parity-verified digit-for-digit against newconv.py's own standalone score_slate() on synthetic test cases spanning the full input range.
